newsitem.title: USA: Kapson Senior stake held by Fusion group.
newsitem.headline: Kapson Senior stake held by Fusion group.

text.p: A group led by Fusion Capital Management Inc said it holds a 5.13 percent stake in Kapson Senior Quarters Corp or 397,500 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 203,000 common shares between November 4 and January 6 at prices ranging from $7.3 to $8.55 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
